target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure P] (F : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0) (X ξ : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (R : ℝ), MeasureTheory.Submartingale X F P → (∀ n, @MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable Ω ℝ _ (F n) (ξ (n + 1))) → (∀ n ω, ξ n ω ≤ R) → (∀ n ω, 0 ≤ ξ n ω) → MeasureTheory.Submartingale (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ξ (k + 1) * (X (k + 1) - X k)) F P
